description: Source code implementing the IPSO On/Off Switch object (3342) for LWM2M protocol, including resource definitions, instance management, and callbacks.

methods.name: get_switch_index
methods.description: Finds the index of a switch instance based on object instance ID.

methods.name: state_post_write_cb
methods.description: Callback invoked after writing switch state, updates timing and counters.

methods.name: on_time_read_cb
methods.description: Reads the on-time duration for a switch instance.

methods.name: off_time_read_cb
methods.description: Reads the off-time duration for a switch instance.

methods.name: time_post_write_cb
methods.description: Callback invoked after writing time resources, resets trigger offset.

methods.name: switch_create
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new IPSO On/Off Switch instance.

methods.name: ipso_switch_init
methods.description: Initializes the IPSO On/Off Switch object and registers it.
